# Statement-coverage floor for the merged unit + acceptance profile.
#
# `scripts/coverage-gate.sh` fails a run whose merged coverage falls below a
# `floor_*` value. The `Coverage` job runs that gate on every pull request
# (RustFS `latest`) and the `latest` cell of the acceptance matrix repeats it on
# `main`, so the number can only move up.
#
# To raise it: run `make coverage` and `make coverage-merge` locally (or read the
# table in the acceptance job of the last `main` run), then update `measured_*`
# and `floor_*` here and run `make coverage-readme` to refresh README.md. The
# `Coverage` job fails if README.md is out of sync with this file.
#
# `measured_*` is what the project last observed; `floor_*` is the enforced
# minimum. The floor is kept below the measurement so environment jitter (a new
# `latest` image, a skip that depends on the server, the host-vs-container
# difference when the fixture is not run through compose) cannot fail a run on
# its own. The 2026-10-19 measurement below was taken on the pull-request branch
# with `podman-compose` on the host, always at least a point and a half above the
# floor.

# Last measurement.
measured_total=77.1
measured_provider=73.2
measured_pkg_rustfs=89.7
measured_commit=fb2cf88
measured_date=2026-10-19

# Enforced floor.
floor_total=75.5
floor_provider=71.5
floor_pkg_rustfs=88.5

# Milestones tracked in the issue tracker (see .github/OPENSSF-BEST-PRACTICES.md).
target=80
gold=90
